name: Tengan Soukichi
source:
One of the "dead" that became a companion of Teru.

A mysterious man with amnesia.

He has a slim and gloomy appearance. He is probably somewhere around 30. He has a calm and reserved personality.

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Richard Tatsumi Wong.[/spoiler]
